title: WooCommerce Variables
description: Configuration variables for deploying WooCommerce atop a WordPress storefront.

WOOCOMMERCE_SERVER_NAME.description: Public virtual host domain name configured for the WooCommerce storefront.

WOOCOMMERCE_LISTEN.description: HTTP bind address:port or UNIX socket exposed for the WooCommerce site.

WOOCOMMERCE_VERSION.description: Target WooCommerce plugin release version or alias (e.g., latest) to install.

WOOCOMMERCE_WWWROOT.description: Filesystem WordPress document root into which the WooCommerce plugin is installed.
